title: AI Safe
description: Every key maps onto the engine's own vocabulary rather than a parallel one: four data groups, each taking one of three decisions. An unrecognised value is ignored and the default applies, because a policy is pushed by somebody who cannot see the result.

ExecutionMode.description: Base configuration. OBSERVE_ONLY enforces nothing and shows nothing: prompts are still checked and counted on the device, but the send is never held and no banner appears. Use it to measure a rollout before enforcing one. The keys below override whichever base is chosen, so an audit rollout that should still speak up about credentials is OBSERVE_ONLY with Secret set to warn.

Secret.description: Live credentials: passwords, API keys, access tokens, private keys, connection strings. Defaults to block.

Personal.description: Personal data: names, email addresses, phone numbers, identity and card numbers. Defaults to warn.

Confidential.description: Company-confidential material: unreleased plans, pricing, project codenames. Defaults to warn.

Internal.description: Internal identifiers: hostnames, network paths, customer, case and contract numbers. Defaults to warn.

UncertainCeiling.description: The strongest response allowed for a finding the engine is not certain about. Defaults to warn, so a possible name can never stop somebody working. Raising this to block is not recommended.

OnEngineUnavailable.description: What to do when the checker cannot be reached at all. Defaults to warn, because 'we found nothing' and 'we could not look' are different states.

AllowlistDigests.description: Identities that need no warning, as lowercase hex SHA-256 digests of 'SALT VALUE' where VALUE is lowercased and has its whitespace collapsed. Plaintext is never accepted, so a policy file cannot carry a list of employee names. Credentials are never suppressible, whatever is listed here.

AllowlistDomainDigests.description: Internal domains that need no warning, digested the same way. A digest of 'corp.internal' also covers api.corp.internal and anyone@corp.internal.

AllowlistSalt.description: The salt the digests above were computed with. Required if either list is set: a digest checked against a different salt never matches, and there is no way to detect that from the digest alone.

AllowUserOverrides.description: Whether a user's own allowlist is honoured alongside this one. Set false to ignore it entirely.
